findings.title: Registry refused the image pull
findings.cause: the registry refused to serve image ghcr.io/sunilmehta-si/kube-diagnose-missing:1.0.0 (it answered 403 forbidden); Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: Back-off pulling image "ghcr.io/sunilmehta-si/kube-diagnose-missing:1.0.0": ErrImagePull: failed to pull and unpack image "ghcr.io/sunilmehta-si/kube-diagnose-missing:1.0.0": failed to resolve reference "ghcr.io/sunilmehta-si/kube-diagnose-missing:1.0.0": failed to authorize: failed to fetch anonymous token: unexpected status from GET request to https://ghcr.io/token?scope=repository%3Asunilmehta-si%2Fkube-diagnose-missing%3Apull&service=ghcr.io: 403 Forbidden
